scripts.build: npm run prisma:generate && npm run build:core
scripts.quality:gate: npm audit --omit=dev --omit=optional && npm run architecture:check && npm run prisma:generate && npm run typecheck:core && npm run test:core && npm run build:core
scripts.desktop:dev: concurrently -k -n web,electron "react-router dev --port 5173 --strictPort" "wait-on http://localhost:5173 && npm run desktop:electron:dev"
scripts.desktop:start: npm run build && npm run desktop:install-app-deps && npm run desktop:electron:prod
scripts.desktop:package: npm run build && npm run desktop:package:base
scripts.desktop:package:mac: npm run build && npm run desktop:package:base -- --mac dmg zip
scripts.desktop:package:win: npm run build && npm run desktop:package:base -- --win nsis
scripts.desktop:package:win:all: npm run build && npm run desktop:package:base -- --win nsis --x64 --arm64
scripts.desktop:package:win:portable: npm run build && npm run desktop:package:base -- --win portable
scripts.desktop:package:win:portable:all: npm run build && npm run desktop:package:base -- --win portable --x64 --arm64
scripts.typecheck: npm run prisma:generate && npm run typecheck:core
scripts.test: npm run prisma:generate && npm run test:core
